hebrewText: יִמְצָאֵ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּ/בְ/תֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֨/נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔/הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖/נְהוּ כְּ/אִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
tokens.kjv: [phrase] be able, befall, being, catch, [idiom] certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), [idiom] have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), [idiom] occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain
tokens.kjv: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.
tokens.explanation: tohu — vazio, caos, sem forma, sem propósito, deserto

tokens.bdb: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
tokens.kjv: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

tokens.bdb: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
tokens.kjv: besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).

tokens.bdb: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.enLiteralWord: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.explanation: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.explanationEn: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
tokens.explanation: ayin — olho, olhos, aparência, fonte (de água), perspectiva
